content:
Less than a week after the release of macOS 26.7.1 and macOS 15.8.1 RC 1, Apple is now pushing out the second release candidate in preparation for the official launch. Here are the details.

macOS 26.7.1 and 15.8.1 RC 2 have been released

Last week, Apple rolled out the first release candidates for macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1. On the same day, Apple also released macOS 27.2 beta 1, rather than the macOS 27.1 beta 1 and its related versions that most users and developers were expecting.

While macOS 27.2 beta 1 added French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish support to Siri AI, the beta versions of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 were relatively quiet, with Apple only saying they "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users."

Apple will most likely publish the relevant security details only after the official release of macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 in the coming weeks.

The macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 RC 2 build is 25G313, while the macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 second RC build is 24H212.

Did you spot anything new in today's RC? Let us know in the comments.
